ranked_features.name: Owner Mode — hidden menu-engineering cockpit
ranked_features.one_liner: A secret second view that flips the menu into a simulated Foodics/FineDine BI dashboard, fed live by the guest taps the owner just made himself.
ranked_features.build_spec: Second full-screen view (div#owner-view, translateY slide-in) opened via ?owner=1 or triple-tap on the wordmark — RESERVE the triple-tap gesture exclusively for this (see warnings). Instrumentation: log {ts, type:'sheet_open'|'cart_add'|'order_send', itemId} to a localStorage ring buffer (cap 500) from handlers that already exist. Blend with a seeded demo dataset (per-item view/order ints in the config object). Four panels, all CSS: (a) star/plowhorse/puzzle/dog matrix — 38 absolutely-positioned gold dots on a hairline grid (left%=popularity, bottom%=margin), tap a dot to show the item name; (b) 'الأكثر مشاهدة / Most viewed' horizontal bars via transform:scaleX on .in-view; (c) 24-cell hour heat strip via opacity steps; (d) three bilingual insight cards templated from seed data, e.g. 'اللاتيه الإسباني يتحمل زيادة ٢ ريال — هامش متوقع +٨٪ / Spanish Latte can absorb a 2 SAR raise — projected +8% margin'. Exit chip 'عودة للقائمة / Back to menu'. No canvas, no charts lib, ~200 lines JS+CSS in the same file.
ranked_features.wow_factor: The owner plays with the guest menu for one minute, you flip him into the cockpit — and his own taps are already plotted on the matrix. 'This is the screen Foodics sells me' — the product reframes from pretty menu to business weapon on the spot.

ranked_features.name: Reasoned cart upsell — the thinking cashier line
ranked_features.one_liner: Cart-shape-aware suggestions that state their reason and their savings, one line at a time (Bite Lift's +20% check pattern).
ranked_features.build_spec: Ordered rules array evaluated as a pure function on every cart change: predicates over category counts, total vs bundle thresholds, party-size inference from drink count. First matching rule renders ONE dismissible hairline line in the existing cart bar — never stacks, respecting the badge budget. Rule copy examples: 3 drinks + no food → 'طلبكم فيه ٣ مشروبات — دلة قهوة للمجلس توفر عليكم ١٢ ريال / Three drinks in your order — a majlis dallah pot saves you 12 SAR' (savings math reuses the existing struck-through anchor logic); 2 desserts + no coffee → 'حلا بدون قهوة؟ / Dessert without coffee?'. ~8 rules, ~60 lines, extends (does not replace) the built dessert upsell.
ranked_features.wow_factor: The owner adds a third drink to the demo cart and the menu whispers a group-aware dallah suggestion with the exact savings — he recognizes a +20% check story instantly because it explains itself like a good cashier.

ranked_features.name: Post-order 5-star moment with Google deep link
ranked_features.one_liner: Every order ends with five gold stars; happy guests land on the cafe's actual Google review page, unhappy ones get a private WhatsApp line to the owner.
ranked_features.build_spec: After the WhatsApp order CTA fires (or request-bill), slide up a small sheet (existing sheet component): 5 inline-SVG gold stars, heading 'شاركنا رأيك / Tell us how it was'. Stars 4–5 → <a href='https://search.google.com/local/writereview?placeid=PLACE_ID'> (pure URL, per-client config, no API); stars 1–3 → wa.me link with prefilled bilingual private feedback: 'أحب أن أشارك ملاحظة خاصة مع صاحب المقهى — I'd like to share private feedback with the owner'. IMPORTANT compliance tweak vs sunday's pattern: keep a small 'أو قيمنا على Google' link visible at every rating so it is routing, not gating (see warnings). Two anchors + one sheet, transform/opacity only.
ranked_features.wow_factor: The moment the owner sees 4 stars deep-link into HIS Google Maps listing, he does the math on footfall — 'this pays for itself' is usually said out loud here.

ranked_features.name: Memory suite: 'your usual' one-tap reorder + abandoned-cart rescue
ranked_features.one_liner: The menu remembers the guest's last order and their unfinished cart — CRM behavior with zero CRM, on the localStorage rails already built.
ranked_features.build_spec: On order send, serialize {items, customizations, total, ts, visitCount} to localStorage (the WhatsApp message builder already serializes this shape). On load with a stored order: slim strip under the sticky header — 'أهلاً بعودتك — طلبك المعتاد؟ سبانش لاتيه، حليب شوفان — ١٩ ر.س / Welcome back — your usual? Spanish Latte, oat milk — 19 SAR' with one 'أعده / Again' chip that rehydrates the cart through existing addToCart + fly-to-bar. If idle >14 days, copy becomes 'اشتقنا لك / We missed you'. Rescue: visibilitychange listener timestamps tab-hide; on return with a non-empty cart older than ~3 min, a non-blocking toast rises: 'مشروبك ما زال بانتظارك — أكمل طلبك (٤٧ ر.س) / Your drink is still waiting — finish your order (47 SAR)'. ~70 lines total, no permissions, survives offline via the PWA.
ranked_features.wow_factor: The owner locks his phone mid-demo, reopens it, and the menu nudges him back to his own cart — an automation he associates with $500/mo US platforms demos itself by accident. Next-day rescan showing his exact usual seals it.

ranked_features.name: Live drink-assembly preview in the customization sheet
ranked_features.one_liner: A CSS cup that visibly builds itself as options are tapped — the single most screenshot-able guest moment (Crav Burgers' stacking move).
ranked_features.build_spec: Inside the existing bottom sheet: a 90px inline-SVG/CSS cup silhouette with 4–5 absolutely-positioned flat layer divs (espresso #3B2418, milk cream, foam, saffron-gold flecks, date syrup). Wiring into option handlers that already exist: sweetness level → transform:scaleY on the syrup layer (transform-origin:bottom); milk choice → background-color transition on the milk layer; priced add-on toggle (saffron) → gold-fleck layer drops in via translateY+opacity; ice → two translucent cubes fade in. No images, transform/opacity only, ~40 lines JS. Caption under the cup: 'كوبك يتكوّن / your cup, taking shape'.
ranked_features.wow_factor: Owner taps 'extra saffron' and gold dust visibly settles into the drawn glass. Phones come out. No cafe menu in the Gulf does this.

ranked_features.name: Split-the-bill calculator (Qlub pattern, offline, honest)
ranked_features.one_liner: Equal or by-item bill splitting with live VAT-inclusive per-person totals — the Gulf-famous feature, without payment rails.
ranked_features.build_spec: Inside the existing cart sheet, a segment control 'قسّم الفاتورة / Split the bill': (a) بالتساوي / Equally — guest-count stepper ٢–٦, total/n with halala rounding rule shown; (b) بالأصناف / By item — person chips, tap item rows to assign, running per-person VAT-inclusive subtotals under each chip. Output: per-person lines appended to the existing structured WhatsApp order message, or individual wa.me share links per person. Honest framing line: 'حاسبة القسمة — الدفع عند الكاشير / split calculator — pay at the counter'. Pure arithmetic over existing cart state + existing sheet UI; RTL-native chips.
ranked_features.wow_factor: The owner recognizes the Qlub experience his group tables ask about — 16-minutes-saved-per-table famous — running with no terminal, no fees, no POS integration.

ranked_features.name: 3-tap Taste Match with counting match percentages
ranked_features.one_liner: Three chip questions, then '٩٢٪ لك' badges count up on a gold 'Picked for you' row — the me&u/Vivino enterprise-AI look, deterministic and offline.
ranked_features.build_spec: Dismissible bottom sheet (existing component), 3 chip-only questions — 'بارد أو حار؟ / iced or hot?', 'حليبي أو أسود؟ / milky or black?', 'حلو أو مايل للمرار؟ / sweet or toward bitter?' — no text inputs (no-forms rule holds). Each of the 38 items carries data-taste='temp,milk,sweet,intensity' (4-int vector, mostly derivable from existing customization metadata). Score = 100 − scaled L1 distance; top 3 render into a 'مختار لك / Picked for you' horizontal row pinned under the header, percentage numerals counting up via one rAF loop, one templated why-line: 'لأنك تميل للبارد الحليبي / because you lean iced and milky'. Preference vector persists in localStorage; every WhatsApp order nudges it 20% toward the ordered item's vector so return visits show updated numbers unprompted. ~120 lines.
ranked_features.wow_factor: Owner answers three taps and watches percentages count up on his own drinks with a stated reason — 'it learned me in ten seconds.' It is the feature FineDine gates behind Premium, on a static file.

ranked_features.name: Catch it from the parade — the marquee becomes orderable
ranked_features.one_liner: Sushiro Digiro's famous move: pluck a passing drink out of the auto-scrolling chef's parade straight into the cart.
ranked_features.build_spec: Upgrade the existing marquee: each floating dish becomes a <button> with aria-label. On tap: read current translateX via getComputedStyle matrix, pause the lane (also solves the moving-target a11y issue), clone the node, FLIP-animate the clone into the cart bar reusing the existing fly-to-bar path, tick the live total, resume the lane after 400ms. Lane direction already mirrors under dir=rtl. Micro-caption above the lane, shown once: 'المس طبقًا وهو يمر / catch a dish as it passes'. ~60 lines vanilla JS, zero new assets, transform/opacity only.
ranked_features.wow_factor: Within the first 10 seconds of the demo the owner plucks a cardamom latte out of the moving parade with one thumb and watches the total tick — the wallpaper just became a toy, and it is Japan's most famous ordering-screen mechanic.

ranked_features.name: The Evening Bar — a zero-proof chapter that appears after 8pm
ranked_features.one_liner: After dark the menu grows a 'بار المساء' chapter with cocktail grammar (coupes, flutes, 'proudly zero-proof') — Tonic Riyadh energy at 1/100th the cost.
ranked_features.build_spec: Inverse of the built breakfast auto-collapse: a 5–7 item chapter hidden until Date().getHours() >= 20, with ?evening=1 override for daytime sales meetings. Its chip appears in the scroll-spy nav at 20:00. Items use cocktail grammar: inline-SVG coupe/flute glyphs, karak-Negroni-style spritz, saffron 'بيلي-نو / Belli-No', sparkling date cordial in a flute; label set once per item as gold small caps EN 'zero-proof' / AR 'بلا كحول بفخر'; three-word taste signatures ('قشدي · تمري · قصير'). Section background steps one shade darker via a single opacity overlay. Reuses chapter, chips, and sheets wholesale.
ranked_features.wow_factor: Riyadh cafes live at night; the owner watches the menu change personality after dark — the most Gulf-native wow in the research, and it mirrors the Four Seasons' Tonic story he has read about.

ranked_features.name: One-tap 9:16 Story Card share
ranked_features.one_liner: A finished gold-on-black Snapchat/Instagram story card per item — every share is a free ad carrying the QR back to the menu.
ranked_features.build_spec: Share glyph in the item bottom sheet. On tap, draw an offscreen 1080x1920 <canvas>: espresso ground, gold hairline arch (same path as the hero arch mask), item name in Noto Kufi (font already loaded — wait on document.fonts.ready), price in bare numerals, cafe wordmark, small QR embedded as a pre-generated per-cafe data-URI (generated at build time, no library). canvas.toBlob → new File → navigator.share({files}) behind a navigator.canShare feature-detect; fallback = download anchor. Bilingual toast on success: 'جاهزة لسناب شات / ready for your story'. ~80 lines, zero network.
ranked_features.wow_factor: The owner taps share on the saffron latte and a designed, branded 9:16 card lands directly in the Snapchat share sheet — he immediately pictures every customer story as a free ad with his QR on it (Snap reaches 90% of eligible Saudis).

warnings: Gesture collision: at least three swarm insights independently claim triple-tap-on-wordmark (Owner Mode, secret menu unlock, Ramadan preview). Assign triple-tap to exactly one (recommend Owner Mode) and move the others to query params or long-press, or demos will misfire in front of buyers.

Review gating is against Google's review policy. sunday's exact pattern (happy → Google, unhappy → private) can get a cafe's reviews filtered or the listing penalized. Ship it as routing with the Google link visible at every star level, and never say 'review gating' on the pitch page.

The existing cinematic gold-particle intro and auto-marquee violate prefers-reduced-motion expectations — vestibular dysfunction affects ~35% of adults 40+. The flagship needs a calm twin (crossfade wordmark, paused-but-swipeable marquee) plus a visible 'تقليل الحركة' switch, or the signature moment is physically sickening a slice of every majlis.

Halation audit: if the espresso ground is true #000 or body text true #FFF, gold and cream text will smear for the ~1-in-3 guests with astigmatism. Verify tokens sit near #0F0E0C ground / #E8E4DC text at >=7:1, and keep peak-bright gold for display sizes only.

Arabic renders visibly smaller than Latin at the same px (lower x-height). The AR body token needs ~10-15% more size and 1.8 line-height vs the EN token, and the file must survive Android font-scale 'Largest' + 200% zoom — competitor menus break here, so this is also a live head-to-head demo win, but only if we actually pass it.

The iOS-style drag-only bottom sheets fail WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.7 (Dragging Movements) as built. Add a visible 44px close button, tap-on-scrim dismissal, and Android back-button handling (history.pushState) — tremor and arthritis hands currently cannot close them.
Making the marquee tappable creates a moving-target accessibility problem — pause the lane on touchstart and keep dish buttons >=44px, or the most fun feature becomes the most frustrating one.

Bilingual screen-reader correctness is currently unaddressed: without lang-of-parts spans, TalkBack reads Arabic names in an English voice and prices as digit strings. Saudi's DGA mandates WCAG 2.1 AA for government-adjacent services — a 2-3 hour markup audit turns this from liability into a pitch line.

Gimmick-overload is the biggest taste risk in the swarm: it surfaced 20+ gamification mechanics (gacha, scratch cards, streaks, collectibles, tiers, drops, secret items). The luxury restraint IS the differentiation — cap playful mechanics at 2-3 visible ones per menu and keep everything else behind opt-in drawers, or the Majlis becomes an arcade.

All localStorage 'loyalty' (stamps, tiers, gift codes) is trivially resettable and vanishes on browser data clear or a different device. Frame these as hospitality gestures with human verification lines in the WhatsApp message ('ختم الولاء: ٦/٨'), never as accounting-grade currency — and say so honestly in the owner pitch.
